title: FCC主席质疑12州：派拉蒙收购，反垄断依据何在？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: A group of about a dozen states is poised to sue, to block the Paramount Skydance Warner Brothers deal.
segments.zh: 约十几个州准备起诉，阻止派拉蒙与Skydance和华纳兄弟的交易。

segments.en: I think they had been prior reporting that various attorneys across those states have been preparing for that anyway.
segments.zh: 此前有报道称，这些州的律师一直在为此做准备。

segments.en: I know that the FCC kind of has a nominal role to look at the foreign financing of such a deal, but I hope you appreciate
segments.zh: 我知道FCC名义上会审查此类交易的外国融资，但希望您能理解

segments.en: I have to ask you about what the latest is there in your reaction to a state-wide antitrust suit.
segments.zh: 我必须问您，对于州层面的反垄断诉讼，最新情况如何？您的反应是什么？

segments.en: Well, it's hard to see a real legitimate antitrust action, but of course, you know, I leave it to the antitrust experts to weigh in on this.
segments.zh: 很难看出这是一起真正的反垄断诉讼，当然，我让反垄断专家来评估。

segments.en: I did think it was interesting that there was a statement, at least, attributed to the California Attorney General that said that they would not sue if Paramount agreed to spin off CNN.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，加州总检察长曾表示，如果派拉蒙同意剥离CNN，他们就不会起诉。

segments.en: It's hard to conceive of a competition antitrust theory that takes you all the way up to the point where owning or not owning CNN as part of that broader group
segments.zh: 很难想象一种竞争反垄断理论会认为，拥有或不拥有CNN作为该集团的一部分

segments.en: is a legitimate line that antitrust or competition law would draw. For our part, we do have a piece of this with respect to some of the foreign investment,
segments.zh: 是反垄断或竞争法划定的合理界限。就我们而言，我们负责其中涉及外国**的部分，

segments.en: and we're running a standard process on that, and we haven't made a final decision there yet.
segments.zh: 我们正在按标准流程处理，尚未做出最终决定。
